method: Every final PDF page independently viewed as its original 918x1188 PNG through view_image(detail=original); no contact-sheet substitution.

page_checks.observations: Cover title, author and date aligned and readable.
Executive summary complete and readable; no clipped lines.
Abstract and heading legible, with deliberate fresh-page start.
Introduction and RQ subsections fit margins; headings retain following text.
RQ continuation and contribution readable; chapter-ending white space acceptable.
Related work and source attribution readable; no stranded headings.
Corpus lineage and independence limitations clear; no overlap.
Model table fits width; long model IDs and methods prose legible.
Corpus table and native equations readable and within margins; no broken table rows.
Rank and cosine equations readable; equation/prose separation adequate.
Transfer equation and both E4 definitions readable; E4 pair now kept on the same page.
Bootstrap and proxy-boundary continuation complete; chapter-ending white space acceptable.
Results denominator text and six-row geometric table readable.
Three-panel geometry figure and explanatory caption readable; integer layer ticks and legends clear.
Nine-row behavior table and three-row E4 table readable with intact rows and numeric intervals.
Behavior/proxy figure readable; legends do not obscure plotted data; surrounding prose within margins.
Five-line chapter-ending continuation readable; no single-line orphan or clipping.
Interpretation and limitations headings and dense prose readable.
External-validity, future-work and conclusion paragraphs fit margins.
All five references readable with hanging indents and resolved display text; no clipped entries.
Appendix evidence table and long model/source hashes wrap within margins; no clipping.

resolved_layout_issues: Combined the two short E4 definitions into one native display so a page break cannot split the pair.
scope: Visual presentation only. Scientific reproduction and source verification are separately recorded in results/.
